description: 1. The agent must run `scripts/analyze.py pipeline/domain.pddl pipeline/problem.pddl` (Formal Mode) to extract RALSTP data from the PDDL files. 2. Using the RALSTP rule (dynamic type = first argument of predicate in action effects), the agent must identify EXACTLY 4 agents: developer, tester, security_scanner, ops_engineer — and must NOT include environment, registry, artifact, or feature_branch as agents (those are static/passive). 3. The agent must classify Entanglement as HIGH because shared predicates between agent pairs (available, busy) total > 3, giving Entanglement Factor = 3. 4. The Buksz Complexity Score must be calculated as 4 × 3 = 12. 5. The landmark chain must trace the mandatory sequence: branch-merged → artifact-ready → tested → cleared → registered → deployed → smoke-passed → ticket-resolved. 6. All 7 required sections of the RALSTP output format (agents_identified, passive_objects, dependency_graph, difficulty_assessment, strategic_phase, tactical_phase, decomposition_suggestion) must appear in ralstp_analysis.json. 7. The decomposition suggestion must mention parallelization opportunities (e.g., dev1 and dev2 can build in parallel; tow security scan after both builds).
